cards.d: When a number is aggregate, it is made up of smaller amounts added together.
cards.e: The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.

cards.d: An antibiotic is a medical drug used to kill bacteria and treat infections.
cards.e: The doctor gave me a shot of an antibiotic when I got the flu.

cards.d: A circuit is a piece of an electronic device that allows electricity to flow.
cards.e: Be very careful not to shock yourself when fixing an electrical circuit.

cards.d: To complement something or someone is to make them better.
cards.e: The wool scarf complemented her lovely eyes.

cards.d: To compress something means to press or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.
cards.e: I compressed my clothes to fit into a single suitcase.

cards.d: A database is a collection of data that is stored in a computer.
cards.e: The company has a database of all the names and accounts of their customers.

cards.d: An equivalent is an amount or value that is the same as another amount or value.
cards.e: I worked the equivalent of sixty hours this week.

cards.d: When someone is immune to a disease, they cannot be affected by it.
cards.e: Children usually get shots to make them immune to certain diseases.

cards.d: Input is information that is put into a computer.
cards.e: Type the input into the computer program.

cards.d: When a relationship is intimate, the two things are very closely connected.
cards.e: I only tell my secrets to my most intimate friends.

cards.d: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron toward it.
cards.e: I used a magnet to pick up the nails that were scattered on the floor.

cards.d: A person’s metabolism is the way chemical processes in their body use energy.
cards.e: If you exercise every day, your metabolism speeds up.

cards.d: A microchip is a small device inside a computer that holds information.
cards.e: I can put more data on my computer if I buy a more powerful microchip.

cards.d: A phase is a stage in a process or the gradual development of something.
cards.e: The first phase in the recycling project involves finding volunteers to help out.

cards.d: To pinch means to take a piece of skin between one’s fingers and squeeze.
cards.e: I pinched my nose, so I couldn’t smell the odor from the garbage.

cards.d: When something is prevalent, it is common.
cards.e: Growing a beard is more prevalent behavior in men than women.

cards.d: When something is quantum, it relates to the behavior of atomic particles.
cards.e: The physics student studied quantum mechanics.

cards.d: A ratio is a relationship between two things expressed in numbers or amounts.
cards.e: The boy to girl ratio is one to three.

cards.d: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round in a larger and larger circle.
cards.e: A strand ofDNA looks like two interlocking spirals.

cards.d: When something is viral, it is a disease or infection that is caused by a virus.
cards.e: The girl was in bed fora week when she had a viral infection.
